derivation: Figure 3.8 of the reference work (p.56 printed), with the assignment the same section calls a critical race on p.57: state 1=00, 2=01, 3=10, 4=11.

The transition (10,2)->3 changes both variables. Through code 11 (state 4) it settles in 4 under 10, through 00 (state 1) in 1: the settled state depends on the race winner, which is exactly the book's example.
(11,2)->3 and (11,1)->4 are the same shape; the book names only (10,2)->3.
Every entry here comes from §10.3 applied to the table, not from the book's prose: the book states two of these and the rule finds six.
